content.solution: Ensure that the InfoSheet contains at least one row with DSG metadata values.

content.detail: Sheet '%s' referenced from DSG InfoSheet is missing in the workbook.

content.solution: Remove or rename the unexpected key from the DSG InfoSheet so it matches the expected metadata keys.

content.solution: Check the DSG STD meta-template and ensure that the study URI is correctly passed to the SSD generator for this SOC type.

content.detail: SSDGenerator: no SOCReference provided for SOC generator.
content.solution: In the SSD sheet, fill the 'hasSOCReference' column for each Study Object Collection row that should generate study objects.

content.detail: VirtualColumnGenerator: no studyUri provided for generator with typeUri [%s].
content.solution: Ensure that the DSG InfoSheet and STD metadata correctly provide a study URI before running the VirtualColumn generator.

content.solution: Make sure the SSD sheet includes a valid SOCReference for each Virtual Column configuration that depends on a Study Object Collection.

content.solution: Open the DSG InfoSheet, check the value of 'hasStudyURI', and confirm it matches the URI of an existing STD in the triple store.

content.detail: DSG ingestion: no Study Object Collection (SOC) of type hasco:SubjectGroup was found for this study.
content.solution: Check the SSD sheet referenced by hasEntityDesign and ensure exactly one SOC row has 'type' set to hasco:SubjectGroup.

content.detail: DSG ingestion: more than one Study Object Collection (SOC) of type hasco:SubjectGroup was found for this study.
content.solution: In the SSD sheet, leave only one SOC row with 'type' = hasco:SubjectGroup and remove or change any additional ones.

content.detail: STD Processing: DSG InfoSheet is missing the 'hasStudyDescription' entry.
content.solution: In the DSG InfoSheet, add a row with key 'hasStudyDescription' pointing to the STD sheet that describes the study.

content.detail: STD Processing: failed to load or parse the sheet referenced by 'hasStudyDescription'.
content.solution: Verify that the sheet named in 'hasStudyDescription' exists, has the expected STD columns, and is not empty.

content.detail: Study ID in the STD sheet is empty or missing.
content.solution: Open the STD sheet and fill the 'studyID' column with a value for this study.

content.detail: Study title in the STD sheet is missing.
content.solution: Open the STD sheet and fill the 'studyTitle' column with a title for this study.

content.detail: DSG file must have a .xlsx extension.

content.detail: Missing sheet name for [hasEntityDesign] in DSG InfoSheet.

content.detail: DSG ingestion: failed to load SSD-related content: %s.
content.solution: Review the referenced sheet or scope in the message (for example, a SOC sheet or SSD scope sheet) and ensure it exists and has the expected header row and data rows.

content.detail: Exception during SSD sheet extraction: %s.

content.detail: Missing InfoSheet.
